name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-super-mario-bros-fireball-podoboo-pack
title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. - Fireball / Podoboo Pack
description:
Made for C3 Summer 2022.

This graphic pack includes not only SMAS-SMB Sprite graphics for the Podoboo and the Reflecting one but also includes giant version of these graphics too for the custom giant Podoboo sprites in the sprites section.

Compatible Normal Sprites
Fireball, vertical
Reflecting Fireball (Note: Palette C is used)

Compatible Custom Sprites:

Vertical Fireball / Podoboo

Giant Podoboo

Giant Reflecting Fireball (Note: Palette C is used)

Credit goes to AwesomeZack for the Reflecting SMB1 (NES) Fireball sprites and i made them SMAS-SMB1 Styled myself.
